name: Assistants API v2 (beta, deprecated)
summary: OpenAI has deprecated the Assistants v2 beta API (`POST /v1/assistants`, `PATCH /v1/assistants/{id}`, `POST /v1/threads/{id}/runs`, `POST /v1/threads/runs`) with a sunset date of August 26, 2026, in favor of the Responses + Conversations APIs.
description: The Assistants v2 beta API stores a default model on `POST /v1/assistants` / `PATCH /v1/assistants/{id}` and can override it on `POST /v1/threads/{thread_id}/runs` / `POST /v1/threads/runs`. Those model slots would need to carry `{connection}/{deployment}` for legacy assistant users to route through APIM AI Gateway instead of a local Foundry deployment. OpenAI announced deprecation on August 26, 2025 and will permanently shut down the Assistants API on August 26, 2026 — see the [Assistants migration guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/assistants/migration).
notes: Deprecated by OpenAI (announced 2025-08-26, sunset 2026-08-26); not recommended for new BYOM work regardless of routing support. Not yet probed against Foundry with a captured server response. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/assistants/migration. See `test.py` for the create-assistant and run wiring; `responses-direct` (Responses API) and Prompt Agents (`prompt-agents-static` / `prompt-agents-dynamic`) are the recommended Foundry successors.
